lines.text: Sunny Saturday at the playground! The giant curly red slide was the main attraction!
A neat line of ducklings, kittens, and bunnies stood waiting patiently!
ZOOM! Buster the puppy charged forward, pushed past the kittens, and raced up the ladder!
Me first, me first! Buster barked, sliding down with a proud grin!
When he reached the bottom, nobody was cheering. His friends folded their arms and walked away!
Buster sat alone by the slide. Flying down is boring when no one is playing with you!
Buster walked over and apologized: I'm sorry for cutting. I'll wait my turn!
Patience and fair play turn simple playground slides into shared happiness!
Play fair and stay kind—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
